candidate_status: v0 reference candidate as of 2026-05-09. Subject to revision based on Phase 2 earthquake test outcomes. See README for the open design choices that may change.
scope: These vectors verify that an indexer's relay (lightwalletd, zaino) returns the same response as the canonical Zebra at the same chain tip. They do NOT evaluate whether v0's parameter choices (oracle type, floor value, quantization scheme) are the right ones — see README and the /adversarial page on the site.
verification_workflow: 1. Sync any Zcash full node + indexer pair to mainnet.
2. Wait until the network is at any chain tip height H.
3. Call z_getstandardfees against both the reference Zebra and your indexer simultaneously.
4. Compare. Both responses must have identical standard_fee, priority_fee, congested, version, and height fields.
5. The how_is_this_calculated field may differ in URI form but must point to the same v0 specification.

v0_invariants.priority_fee_relation: priority_fee MUST equal standard_fee × priority_multiplier (10 in v0)
v0_invariants.standard_fee_floor: standard_fee MUST be at least the floor parameter (currently 1000 in v0; this floor value is itself an open design choice — see README)
v0_invariants.standard_fee_buckets: standard_fee MUST be a power of 10 in v0 (1000, 10000, 100000, ...). Alternative quantization schemes are under consideration; vectors for v0.x or v1 would replace this invariant.
v0_invariants.version_string: version MUST be exactly the string "v0" for this candidate. A version bump signals a parameter or algorithm change.
v0_invariants.congested_flag_semantics: congested MUST be true iff the total synthetic-fill count across the lookback window is zero (every block was full)

open_design_choices._note: These choices are currently fixed in v0 as shipped, but are explicitly subject to change based on Phase 2 earthquake-test outcomes.

oracle_type.settled_by: E4 manipulation bounds + Stability falsifier + Mohak's MedianPoisoning + MinerSelfDealing scenarios

floor_fee.current_v0_assumes: the marginal-fee reduction draft (5000 → 1000) has shipped on mainnet
floor_fee.settled_by: F1 anti-spam falsifier + Mohak's floor_fee_saturation scenario + the marginal-fee draft's compatibility analysis

quantization.settled_by: F4 privacy falsifier (bucket-flip timing) + Mohak's BucketBoundaryNudging scenario

captured_responses.notes: Mainnet uncongested baseline. Standard at v0 floor (1000), priority at 10x, congested flag false. Synthetic fill dominated the lookback window.

future_work: Add synthetic test vectors: mock block sequences with deterministic expected outputs, enabling unit-test conformance verification of any v0 implementation independent of mainnet state.
Add congested-state captures from historical periods of full blocks.
Add programmatic verifier (Rust binary or Python script) automating real-time comparison.
Republish vectors when v0 design choices are settled by Phase 2 outcomes (likely versioned as v0.1, v0.2, or v1).
